param_input_item.param_description: The command string (for example from tessera.lsystem).

param_output_item.param_description: An n-by-2 [x y] path; NaN rows break the polyline at branches.

description.p: Interpret an L-system / turtle-graphics command string as a 2-D path. F and G draw forward, f moves without drawing, + and - turn left and right by `angle` degrees, and [ and ] push and pop the turtle state for branching; other characters are ignored. Combined with tessera.lsystem it draws plants, trees and classic fractal curves.

xmldoc.bibliography: M. Hendrikx, S. Meijer, J. van der Velden, A. Iosup, Procedural Content Generation for Games: A Survey, ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications and Applications 9(1), 2013. DOI 10.1145/2422956.2422957.
